cards.audioText: Your call sign is AFR9939, you are flying from Wuhan to Beijing, your position now is gate 276, information B is valid, ask ATC for your airway clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是法航9939，你正从武汉飞往北京，你现在在276号机位，通播B有效，向管制请求你的航路许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, AFR9939, gate 276, information B, request ATC clearance to Beijing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，法航9939，276号机位，通播B，请求前往北京的放行许可。

cards.audioText: ATC: AFR9939, Wuhan Delivery, you are cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, runway in use 04, follow HZ-01 Departure, initially 1200 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, departure frequency 119.6, squawk 3101.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航9939，武汉放行，可以经由计划航路飞往北京，跑道04，按照HZ-01离场，初始爬升至1200米，巡航高度10400米，离场频率119.6，应答机编码3101。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, runway in use 04, follow HZ-01 Departure, initially 1200 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, departure frequency 119.6, squawk 3101. AFR9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往北京，跑道04，按照HZ-01离场，初始爬升至1200米，巡航高度10400米，离场频率119.6，应答机编码3101，法航9939。

cards.audioText: Now, you are on taxiway A1, request taxi instructions from Ground controller.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在滑行道A1，向地面管制请求滑行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR9939, taxiway A1, request to continue taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，法航9939，滑行道A1，请求继续滑行。

cards.audioText: ATC: AFR9939, Wuhan Ground, taxi via A1, A, M, to holding point M2. Caution work in progress at right side of M.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航9939，武汉地面，经由滑行道A1，A和M，滑行至M2等待点，注意M右侧有施工。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via A1, A, M, to holding point M2, roger caution, thanks, AFR9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道A1，A和M，滑行至M2等待点，收到，谨慎滑行，法航9939。

cards.audioText: You are approaching the holding point M2, inform Tower that you are ready for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在到达M2等待点，告知武汉塔台，你准备好起飞了。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR9939, approaching holding point M2, request departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，法航9939，到达M2等待点，请求起飞。

cards.audioText: ATC: AFR9939, you are cleared for immediate takeoff, runway 04, surface wind 300 at 2 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航9939，可以立刻起飞，跑道04，地面风300, 2米每秒。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for immediate takeoff, runway 04, AFR9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以立刻起飞，跑道04，法航9939。

cards.audioText: While you are accelerating for takeoff rolling, you notice a yellow ground vehicle is crossing runway 04, tell ATC you stopped immediately because of runway incursion.
cards.audioTextZh: 你在起飞滑跑时，你看到一辆黄色的地面车辆正在穿过跑道04，由于跑道入侵，你立刻停止。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR9939, we rejected takeoff due runway incursion, vehicle crossing runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，法航9939，由于跑道入侵，我们中断起飞，跑道上有车辆。

cards.audioText:
ATC: Roger, AFR9939, advise intention when able.
[Tell ATC, you want to vacate runway via E2 and taxi back to the apron to have a ground check.]
cards.audioTextZh:
收到，法航9939，方便时告知意图。
告诉管制员，你想经由E2脱离跑道，滑回机坪进行检查。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR9939, request vacate runway via E2 and taxi back to the apron to have a ground check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，法航9939，请求经由E2脱离跑道，滑回机坪进行检查。

cards.audioText: Later, everything is normal again, you are finally in the air, passing 600 meters for 1200 meters, tell Departure that you require further instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: 后来，一切恢复正常，你最后升空，现在过600米，飞往1200米，告诉离场，请求进一步指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, AFR9939, passing 600 meters for 1200 meters, request further instructions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，法航9939，过600米，飞往1200米，请求进一步指令。

cards.audioText: ATC: AFR9939, Wuhan Departure, continue climb to 3000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航9939，武汉离场，继续爬升至3000米。

cards.audioText: Now, you are cruising at 10400 meters, suddenly the air becomes very turbulent, you suspect there is a moderate to severe clear air turbulence. Request a lower level.
cards.audioTextZh:
你现在巡航在10400米，忽然气流变得很颠簸，你猜测中度到重度颠簸，请求下高度。
参考答案：
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR9939, at 10400 meters, request lower level due moderate to severe clear air turbulence.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，法航9939，10400米，由于中度到重度颠簸，请求下高度。

cards.audioText:
ATC: Roger, descend to 8900 meters, report if there is any injury on board.
[Your purser reports that there is a passenger with head injuries because of the turbulence.]
cards.audioTextZh:
收到，下到8900米，报告机上是否有人伤亡。
乘务长报告由于颠簸，机上有乘客头部受伤。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 8900 meters, purser reports we have a passenger with head injury. AFR9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下到8900米，乘务长报告有乘客头部受伤，法航9939。

cards.audioText:
ATC: Passenger with head injury, roger that, say intention, AFR9939.
[The purser has offered first aid to the injured passenger, he is OK now. You will continue the flight.]
cards.audioTextZh:
有乘客头部受伤，收到，报告意图，法航9939。
乘务长向受伤乘客提供了急救，他目前情况良好，你将继续飞行。
cards.referenceText: The passenger is OK now, we will continue the flight. AFR9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 乘客情况目前良好，我们将继续飞行，法航9939。

cards.audioText: ATC: AFR9939, roger, direct to ENH, then, descent to 6000 meters, establish contact with Beijing Control 120.6.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航9939，直飞ENH，然后下到6000米，联系北京区调120.6。
cards.referenceText: Direct to ENH, descent to 6000 meters, contact Beijing Control on 120.6. AFR9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞ENH，然后下到6000米，联系北京区调120.6，法航9939。

cards.audioText: Now you are over Beijing Capital airport, you have established ILS for runway 36R, tell Beijing Tower about your situation, request ambulance on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在到达北京首都机场上空，你已经建立跑道36右盲降，告诉北京塔台你的意图，请求到达后急救车就位。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, AFR9939, ILS established runway 36R, we have a passenger with head injury, request ambulance on arrival.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，法航9939，建立跑道36右盲降，我们有一名乘客头部受伤，请求到达后急救车就位。

cards.audioText: ATC: AFR9939, Beijing Tower, ambulance will be ready on your arrival, cleared to land, runway 36R, wind calm.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航9939，北京塔台，到达后救护车将就位，可以落地，跑道36右，静风。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land, runway 36R, thank you, AFR9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以落地，跑道36右，谢谢，法航9939。
